primaryObject: TROVE: Adaptive Agent Skill Orchestration via Trace-Grounded Route Validation and Editing
researchQuestion: How should an agent separate a useful multi-step route proposal from the smaller amount of execution commitment justified by current runtime evidence?
coreProposition: A plan may extend several steps into the future, but execution commitment should advance one observable boundary at a time; route validity remains separate from external-effect authority.
evidenceBoundary: The arXiv paper is the primary evidence family; all benchmark results are source-reported and were not independently reproduced; the Proposal/Boundary/Commitment/Effect model is Research Center synthesis.
title_en: A Plan Is Not a Commitment: What TROVE Changes About Agent Orchestration
title_zh: 计划不是承诺：TROVE 为什么把 Agent 路径拆成提议与逐步提交
